messages:
Ravi: Heads-up 10: saw some odd attribution splits after the last run of launch posts + webinar outreach. Dashboard shows sessions up 22% but MQLs flat. Can we do a quick check before weekly KPI review?
Nora: Yep. My quick note: we had two CTA variants: /r/launch and /r/announce. The tracking template was updated mid-campaign which might have created 'utm_medium=unknown' rows.
Sam (demand): Also the webinar mailer used a redirect through our partner tracking which appends ?src=partnerX rather than utm_source. That likely lands in 'referral' bucket.
Ravi: Oof, that'd split attribution. Could be why campaign-level CPL looks worse.
Nora: I'll run the attribution reconciliation and look for sessions with partnerX in the referrer domain.
Sam (demand): For context, webinar registrants had 3x higher watch rate, but the volume was small vs launch posts. Might be high LTV but not moving MQLs overall.
DataBot: Quick query run: sessions by landing_template:
```
landing_template, sessions, leads, mqls
home_v2, 12840, 320, 18
launch-hero, 4620, 98, 6
announce-lite, 3240, 52, 2
```
Nora: Interesting 7% conversion on home_v2 but much lower on announce-lite. Does announce-lite have the short form?
Lina: Yes announce-lite uses a 2-field form (email, name) with progressive profiling later. That might drop MQL signal until later events.
Ravi: OK action list: Nora to produce attribution reconciled CSV (utm_source + referrer + landing_template), DataBot to add dashboard annotation for partner redirect, Sam to surface partner LTV context in Monday's review, Lina to flag announce-lite in nurture flows (it might need extra triggers). Aim for updates by Monday 09:00 PT.
Nora: On it. I'll ping here with the CSV link once ready.
DataBot: Dashboard annotation created: "2026-03-20 partner redirect traffic mapped to referral; may distort utm_source metrics."
Ravi: Thanks all. If anyone spots a big discrepancy before Monday shout here.
Sam (demand): Also recommend a short blurb in the KPI chat noting the different registration-to-mql timing for announce-lite so people don't assume poor performance immediately.
Lina: Happy to draft that blurb.
Ravi: Great. Closing this quick triage.
